name: Sever
description: Sealed under ice for millennia. This ancient blade contains the power of eternal frost.
skill_description: Using [Sever - Moment of Extreme Cold] freezes time itself. Allows the wielder to strike before fate unfolds.

name: Demon Breaker
description: Emitting a chilling demonic aura. This blade was forged in the abyss to hunt the unholy.
skill_description: Use [Demon Breaker] to fire countless projectiles that pierce through all enemies in their path.

name: Ascending Dragon
description: A spear nurtured above thunderclouds. Crackling with the fury of a thousand storms.
skill_description: Use [Thunder Shock] to summon thunderclouds that unleash automatic lightning strikes upon foes.

name: Hunting Bow
description: A sturdy longbow carved from ancient oak. Favored by rangers of the northern valleys.
skill_description: Use [Thunderclap] to call down a single devastating bolt from the heavens.

name: Round Shield
description: A sturdy round shield forged for the frontline.
skill_description: Raise it to block incoming strikes.
